answer: The protocol requires agents to solve identity-bound computational puzzles, ensuring 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. A verifier rejects any hollow output lacking a unique nonce, forcing each entity to compute fresh proofs. This signal of dedicated work prevents sybil-farms from cloning identities. Any evidence of redundant puzzle-solving triggers immediate account cancellation, serving as a fable of wasted effort for attackers. The mechanism assumes the computational cost is strictly enforced for each slot without resource pooling.
